text:
maya: Quick design pass — noticed a few UX & copy nits in Compliance > Data retention + KMS area. Sharing Figma in thread. Can we do a short sync?
arjun: Uploaded two variants for the KMS badge: short "BYOK" pill and longer "Customer-managed key" pill. Fig: https://www.figma.com/file/xxxxx/retention-kms
lina: I prefer the pill that says "Customer-managed key" for clarity. BYOK acronym isn't obvious for non infra folks. But the longer label pushes the row height a bit.
priya: Accessibility note — the KMS badge color+white icon fails AA on the light background (contrast ~3.2:1). Need stronger border or darker fill. Also the badge must have an aria-label that reads the status, e.g. "Key ownership: Customer-managed key, stored in us-east-1".
sam: Security nit — don't surface full KMS key IDs in UI. If we show an identifier, truncate to last 4 and put an info tooltip. Also avoid copy that implies we manage key material. Prefer "uses a customer-managed key" over "customer key stored".
arjun: Good call on truncation. Proposed microcopy for tooltip: "Customer-managed key (BYOK). Only metadata shown; key material never leaves the customer's KMS." Thoughts?
jules: Legal prefers stronger language: "Key material is controlled by customer KMS and is not retained by Redwood." But flags: we should vet this with compliance before shipping any absolute phrasing.
priya: Also focus order: when tabbing the region dropdown -> KMS badge -> retention selector. Right now the badge is after the retention selector visually but becomes focusable earlier. We should match visual order to avoid confusion for screen reader users.
lina: Re: region dropdown copy — current default says "Default region: Automatic" which stumped a couple PMs. Suggestion: show actual region name, e.g. "Default region: US East (IAD) — auto routed". Shorter: "US East (IAD) — automatic routing".
maya: Audit log timestamps — product asked for relative times (e.g., "3 days ago") but compliance/regulators want absolute ISO with timezone. We need both.
arjun: UI proposal: show human-friendly relative label in list, with an inline UTC timestamp as secondary text. On hover show full ISO 8601 + offset in tooltip.
lina: Example implementation in the table cell:
```
Mar 18, 2026 — 2:12 PM (UTC)
3 days ago
```
and tooltip: `2026-03-18T14:12:03Z`.
sam: Audit preference: logs used for forensics should have precise times. Use `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss±hh:mm` (ISO 8601 with offset). For storage/exports, store timezone-aware UTC in backend, show localized time per user prefs.
jules: Also watch wording in audit entries — the phrase "key material" is sensitive. Use "key metadata" in UI copy and reserve "key material" for legal/compliance docs only.
audit-bot: policy-scan: flagged copy line "we retain key material" in designs.png: line 23. Severity: medium. Suggested replacement: "we do not store key material." (requires legal approval)
priya: Small a11y detail: retention dropdown uses `aria-describedby` pointing to helper text that gets hidden when collapsed. That breaks screen readers. Make helper persistent or move content into `aria-label`.
maya: Action items: 1) Arjun to update badge copy + add tooltip variant (BYOK tooltip + truncated key id) 2) Lina to implement timestamp cell with tooltip pattern and run UX perf check for row height 3) Priya to PR focus-order + contrast fixes 4) Sam/Jules to sign off on approved legal/security microcopy. I'll set a 48h review.
lina: I'll mock the timestamp tooltip and attach a screenshot once done. ETA EOD tomorrow.
arjun: I'll try a compact badge version that keeps a single-line layout and a stacked variant for narrow widths.
sam: I'll draft recommended redaction pattern for key IDs (e.g., `arn:...:key/xxxx-xxxx-XXXX` -> show `••••-XXXX`) and paste it in thread.
maya: Thanks all — moving to a 15m sync if anyone wants to talk through tradeoffs. Otherwise I'll collect review comments here. :thumbsup:
